messages:
jamie: Heads-up — rolling v2026.3 to prod in ~5m. This run includes the embedding-routing tweak. Please watch SLO dashboards (p95, 5xx) and call out any spikes. Deploy-bot will shift traffic 5% every 5m. Thanks.

deploy-bot: [deployment] v2026.3 canary started -> 5%.

olivia: seeing p95 jump on /v1/embeddings from 120ms -> 420ms for EU-west canary nodes. Dashboard: https://grafana.company/shot/ABCD1234 . 5xx steady though.

jamie: @olivia can you paste the alert query and time window? Also which hosts?

olivia: query: `sum(rate(route_p95_ms[5m])) by (route, region)` window 5m -> nodes eu-west-2a,d. Logs show `kvcache-miss` entries. Short snippet:
```
kvcache-miss route=embeddings host=eu-west-2a count=42
```

mike: if kvcache misses, maybe the canary didn't warm prefix cache. Recommend pause traffic shift and increase canary to 10% with slower ramp to warm.

jamie: Deploy-bot, hold at current percentage. Do not shift until further notice.

deploy-bot: [action] hold applied — traffic will remain at 5%. Notifying oncall.

tara: quick check — release notes include cache-warming fix? I only see quantization change and routing flag. We should add note about "prefix cache seeding" in the docs.

jamie: good call. @tara add short bullet to release_notes.md and link it in the thread.

tara: done: https://git.company/notes/v2026.3#cache-seed

olivia: p95 trending down after 3m, eu-west nodes back to ~140ms. 5xx still fine. Looks transient as traffic normalized and cache warmed.

mike: can we resume with a slower ramp: +5% in 10m steps? reduces shock. :thumbsup:

jamie: agreed. Deploy-bot, resume with 5% every 10m until 30%, then reassess. Also enable `observability-sample=on` for tracing.

deploy-bot: [deployment] resume policy updated -> 5% / 10m. observability-sample=on for canary

olivia: continuing to monitor dashboards and trace samples. Will post if any >200ms p95 or >0.5% 5xx for 10m window.

jamie: thanks — keep this thread for the deploy window. If things look stable at 30% we proceed to full ramp. Otherwise we'll pin back to prior version.

deploy-bot: [info] current canary 10% @ 1766551278. Next shift scheduled +10m.

mike: FYI — if we need to pin, version to roll back is `v2026.2` (hotfix-2026.2). I have the command ready.

jamie: ack. tagging oncall incase we need fast rollback: @olivia @mike

olivia: got it. no alerts atm. monitoring until full cutoff.

mike: :ok_hand:

jamie: 10m check: p95 stable, no 5xx. proceeding to next shift in 2m.

deploy-bot: [deployment] moved to 15% @ 1766551299.

olivia: observed slight tail latency on a small subset (eu-west-2b) but within SLO. marking as watched. If that crosses threshold we'll pause again.

jamie: copy. keeping watch — anyone seeing anything else speak up, otherwise we continue.
